newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-ZABEL DISQUALIFIED FROM STAGE VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ZABEL DISQUALIFIED FROM STAGE VICTORY.

text.p: German Erik Zabel was disqualified from victory in the sixth stage of the Tour de France on Friday because of dangerous tactics in the finishing sprint.

Belgian rider Tom Steels was excluded from the Tour for "a violent gesture" towards other riders in the same sprint finish. He was found guilty of throwing a plastic drinking bottle at French rider Frederic Moncassin.
Victory was awarded to Dutchman Jeroen Blijlevens, who had crossed the line second in the 217.5-km stage from Le Blanc.
After studying a video of the finish race officials placed Zabel last because of "irregular sprinting".
Frenchman Cedric Vasseur retained the overall race lead.
